units: Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXII, 10 עַיְּינֵי (Paeli).—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:17">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>איבעי ליה עַיּוּנֵי</he> (<he>עַיּוּנֵיה</he>) he ought to have been on his guard; <cite ref="Makkot 8a">Macc. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לעַיּיוּנֵיה</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 8:17">Targ. Job VIII, 17</cite> <he>יְעַיֵּין</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>יְעוֹיִן</he>).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 14b:14">M. Kat. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>לעיוני בדיניה</he> to study his case (not to decide it).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 14b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>אתו מצפרא ומְעַיְּינֵי בדיניה וכ׳</he> they meet in the morning and consider his case …, and then they come again at sunset &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:21">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>עַיֵּין אי וכ׳</he> examine and see whether &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:14">Ib. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמעייני ביה בדינא</he> while they were arguing about him in court.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:8">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ומְעַיְּינִינָא וכ׳</he> and we argue on his case.
<cite ref="Megillah 30b:7">Meg. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מְעַיְּינִינָן במילי דמתא</he> we look into the affairs (the moral condition) of the town.
<cite ref="Gittin 60a">Gitt. 60ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 14b:13">Tem. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>מְעַיְּינֵי בספרא וכ׳</he> used to study the book of &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:10">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בחינה עיוני בעלמא היא</he> ‘to probe’ (<he>בחן</he>) means merely to investigate (without decreeing).
Ber. 55ᵃ דמְעַיּין בה when he thinks of his prayer (expecting its fulfilment), v. preced; a. fr.—[Pol. עוֹנֵן, v. עֲנַן.]
